[[EXPERIMENT_TITLE]] - Loading Isotherm Determination Report

Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End Date / Report Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

Objective

Determination of loading isotherms for [[LIGAND_NAME]] binding to the chromatography resin using automated liquid handling and robotic manipulation, across [[NUMBER_OF_SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] different salt concentrations ([[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]) and [[NUMBER_OF_LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] different ligand concentrations ([[LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]).

The experiment aims to quantify the equilibrium binding behavior and derive loading isotherms based on spectrophotometric measurements calibrated with a known standard curve (slope [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_SLOPE]], intercept [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_INTERCEPT]] at [[MEASUREMENT_WAVELENGTH]] nm).

Methods

General Experimental Conditions
  • Resin mass per well: [[RESIN_MASS]]
  • Buffer: [[BUFFER]]
  • Salt species: [[SALT_NAME]]
  • Salt stock concentration: [[SALT_STOCK_CONCENTRATION]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]
  • Ligand: [[LIGAND_NAME]]
  • Ligand stock concentration: [[LIGAND_STOCK_CONCENTRATION]] [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]
  • Ligand concentration range: [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]
  • Number of ligand concentrations: [[NUMBER_OF_LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]]
  • Salt concentration range: [[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]
  • Number of salt concentrations: [[NUMBER_OF_SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]]
  • Total volume per well: [[TOTAL_VOLUME]]
  • Incubation temperature: [[INCUBATION_TEMPERATURE]]
  • Incubation shaker speed: [[SHAKER_SPEED_INCUBATION]]
  • Number of technical replicates per condition: [[REPLICATES]]
  • Measurement wavelength: [[MEASUREMENT_WAVELENGTH]] nm
Automated Workflow Overview

The loading isotherm experiment was executed using an integrated automated platform comprising an Opentrons OT-2 liquid handler, a UR5 robotic arm, a vacuum manifold with controlled pump, and a Tecan Spark plate reader. The following sequence summarizes the automated workflow:

  1. Preparation and conditioning of resin plate
    • The Opentrons OT-2 executed an equilibration protocol on a 96-well filter plate (custom labware file: cytiva_96_filterwellplate_1ml.json), dispensing buffer and salt solutions according to the predefined [[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] and [[EQUILIBRATION_VOLUME]].
    • The UR5 robotic arm transferred a 96-deep-well plate ("96DeepWP") from storage to the vacuum manifold position and placed the vacuum manifold.
    • The UR5 moved the equilibrated filter plate from the OT-2 deck to the vacuum manifold.
    • The vacuum pump applied suction at [[PUMP_SPEED]] for [[PUMP_DURATION]] seconds to pull liquid through the resin bed.
    • After pumping, the system vented for [[VENTING_TIME]] seconds to release vacuum before the UR5 returned the filter plate to the OT-2 position.
  2. Equilibration cycles
    • The above equilibration sequence was repeated for [[EQUILIBRATION_CYCLES]] cycles, each with an effective cycle duration of [[EQUILIBRATION_CYCLE_DURATION]] seconds.
    • In each cycle, the OT-2 re-loaded buffer/salt equilibration volume ([[EQUILIBRATION_VOLUME]]) onto the filter plate, followed by UR5 transfers to and from the vacuum manifold, vacuum application at [[PUMP_SPEED]] for [[PUMP_DURATION]] seconds, and venting for [[VENTING_TIME]] seconds.
  3. Final equilibration and preparation for ligand loading
    • After the equilibration loop, the UR5 removed the vacuum manifold and returned the deep-well plate to storage.
    • The OT-2 ran a final equilibration / wash protocol on the filter plate to ensure consistent starting conditions.
    • A manual pause was introduced for user intervention: covering the filter plate with foil, refreshing tips, and clearing waste, according to on-screen instructions.
    • The OT-2 then performed the ligand loading setup protocol using freshly prepared [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] solutions and [[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] in the specified buffer [[BUFFER]], dispensing a total volume of [[TOTAL_VOLUME]] per well onto the equilibrated resin.
  4. Incubation
    • Following loading, plates were incubated at [[INCUBATION_TEMPERATURE]] with shaking at [[SHAKER_SPEED_INCUBATION]] for [[INCUBATION_TIME]] to allow ligand-resin binding to reach equilibrium.
  5. Post-loading filtration and collection
    • After incubation, the UR5 transferred a fresh 96-deep-well plate to the vacuum manifold position and placed the vacuum manifold.
    • The UR5 moved the filter plate containing loaded resin to the vacuum manifold over the deep-well plate to collect flow-through.
    • The vacuum pump again applied suction at [[PUMP_SPEED]] for [[PUMP_DURATION]] seconds, followed by venting for [[VENTING_TIME]] seconds.
    • The UR5 then returned the filter plate to storage and reconfigured plates on the OT-2 deck as needed for subsequent handling.
  6. Preparation of measurement plate
    • The UR5 placed a fresh measurement plate ("WP1") on the OT-2 deck.
    • The OT-2 executed a transfer protocol to distribute flow-through samples (containing unbound ligand) into the measurement plate wells, preserving the matrix of [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] and [[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] and replicates [[REPLICATES]].
  7. Spectrophotometric measurement
    • The UR5 transported the prepared measurement plate from the OT-2 deck to the Tecan Spark plate reader.
    • The Tecan Spark performed absorbance measurements at [[MEASUREMENT_WAVELENGTH]] nm using a method compatible with the calibration curve (slope [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_SLOPE]], intercept [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_INTERCEPT]]).
    • Upon completion, the UR5 removed the plate from the Tecan Spark and returned it to storage.

This fully automated workflow ensures consistent handling of resin, ligands, and buffers across all salt and ligand concentration conditions, minimizing manual variability in the determination of loading isotherms.

Results

Loading Isotherms
[[PLOT_1]]

Figure 1: Loading isotherms of [[LIGAND_NAME]] on the resin at different [[SALT_NAME]] concentrations ([[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]). Each curve represents the equilibrium bound ligand per resin mass ([[RESIN_MASS]]) as a function of the initial ligand concentration ([[LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]), derived from flow-through absorbance measurements at [[MEASUREMENT_WAVELENGTH]] nm using the calibration curve (slope [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_SLOPE]], intercept [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_INTERCEPT]]). Replicates per condition: [[REPLICATES]].
